title: Degeneracy Counting Quantum Algorithm using Decoherence
abstract: arXiv:2608.14941v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Counting the global optima of a classical optimization problem is a #P-hard task. We develop the canonical thermal pure quantum (CTPQ) state-based degeneracy counting (CTPQsd#) algorithm that determines the number of global optima of a classical optimization problem P by measuring only a small probe S, without finding individual minima. The method exploits a perturbative relation between the decoherence measure of S and the degeneracy of P when S and P are together in a CTPQ state. We provide the first numerical demonstration that this relation can be used to count the global minima, applying it to problems encoded by diagonal random-energy Hamiltonians as a maximally unstructured testbed for classical binary optimization problems. Classical simulations of up to 20 problem qubits quantify the algorithm's sensitivity to variations in the temperature of the CTPQ state, the Hamiltonian energy range, the problem size, and degeneracy. translated_title: 利用退相干进行简并度计数的量子算法
translated_abstract: 计算经典优化问题的全局最优解数量是一个#P难任务。我们开发了基于正则热纯量子（CTPQ）态的简并度计数算法（CTPQsd#），该算法通过仅测量一个小探针S来确定经典优化问题P的全局最优解数量，而无需找到各个最小值。该方法利用了当S和P共同处于CTPQ态时，S的退相干度量与P的简并度之间的微扰关系。我们首次数值证明了这种关系可用于计算全局最小值，并将其应用于由对角随机能量哈密顿量编码的问题，作为经典二元优化问题的最大非结构化测试平台。对多达20个问题量子比特的经典模拟量化了算法对CTPQ态温度、哈密顿能量范围、问题大小和简并度变化的敏感性。我们确立了该算法的有效性边界和实际适用性。
tldr: 提出了一种基于正则热纯量子态和退相干测量的新量子算法，能高效计算经典优化问题的全局最优解数量，无需找到具体解，并首次通过数值实验验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: A novel quantum algorithm leveraging canonical thermal pure quantum states and decoherence measurements efficiently counts the number of global optima in classical optimization problems without finding individual solutions, with first numerical validation.
